study: Shared actual per-frame RGB observations for learned state selection
problem: Three-anchor descriptors can miss intermediate appearance changes. Per-frame ordinary controls must not be deprived of image evidence the proposed selector uses.
intervention: Extract the existing three-part104binHSV descriptor for every provided candidate observation, once per target video; reuse across both source checkpoints and every ordinary/proposed learner.
verification: At all6400 earlier anchor observations, descriptors must be byteequal to the completed image-only audit; no GT semantic labels or source checkpoint selection.
no_innovation_or_HOTA_claim: This is shared perception input preparation. Later learning comparisons must use the same full/sparse neural features and RGB inputs.
stronger_baseline_needed: Check dense per-frame ordinary teacher heads with zero fixed source-logit residual and adequate fitting; historical frameKD used a fixed source residual. Reuse full frozen PCD on NAS consistently rather than assuming nearest-anchor inference is the final task.
costs: Measure actual image decoding and histogram work; shared prep wall is not per-method cold deployment.
